_doc: Motedis' slot nut with a ball (Nutenstein mit Steg) for its I-type 8 mm slot, M8. Motedis gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-8-i-motedis-m8-roll-in

slot.rule: Motedis' I-type 8 mm slot (slot-8-motedis-i), whose nuts are item's family (its nut_family is slot-8-item)

thread.rule: Thread M8, sold as M4, M5, M6, M8

nut_kind.rule: Swivelled in through the opening after assembly; a sprung ball holds it in an upright beam

length.rule: Along the slot: 22 on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
length.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Steg I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8ISMONM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8ISMONM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Steg-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

width.rule: Across the slot: 13,5 on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Steg I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8ISMONM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8ISMONM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Steg-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

height.rule: The body under the lips: 7,2 overall less the 0,8 step, on the drawing (the ball stands 1,8 below), from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Steg I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8ISMONM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8ISMONM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Steg-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
tongue_width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Steg I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8ISMONM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8ISMONM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Steg-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step, on the drawing, from the M5's drawing: taken to be the same body
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Steg I Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8ISMONM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8ISMONM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Steg-I-Typ-Nut-8-M5 (the M5's drawing: Motedis draws one size)

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot

material.value: steel, galvanized, with a stainless ball
material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring in an 8 mm slot (M8) at 2200 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m8 thread set (ISO 898-1)
